commits.subject: Restore the BlueValues the release was exported with
commits.body:
FontForge exported the release from src/LilitaOne-Regular.otf
(tools/generate/HOWTOGEN.txt) and snapped its OS/2 x-height and cap
height to these zones. This .sfd re-imports that TTF (ttf2sfd.py),
which cannot carry a private dictionary. Value: the .otf's CFF Private
BlueValues.
